cards.name: Plateau Wipe
cards.summary: Film Impact 'transformer' wipe: a soft-edged angled wipe (default 30 degrees, Wipe Feather 50) in which both pictures are lifted toward camera as the edge passes (Lift Clip A 100, Lift Clip B 50), with motion blur. With defaults on footage it reads as a soft diagonal wipe with a slight push-in, spread over the whole duration rather than a hard line.
use_for: energetic scene change in travel/action B-roll montages
reel beat-cut between two moving shots
trailer act break when both shots have strong motion
explainer chapter jump with a bit of depth
avoid: static talking-head to talking-head cuts: the lift feels gratuitous
slow documentary passages: too flashy
reusing it on every cut: the lift becomes a gimmick
cards.equivalent: AE: Linear Wipe (Transition) at about 30 degrees with a wide Feather on the outgoing layer, both layers scaled up a little (100 -> 110) across the wipe, plus layer motion blur.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026 (bundled catalog v26.0.0, no separate install), match name AE.AE_Impact_Plateau_Wipe; the batch has no match, so apply by the exact name 'Plateau Wipe'. Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 514 s cut (513.52-514.52 s), with no error; centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Lift Clip A 100, Lift Clip B 50, Angle 30, Animate Angle 30, Wipe Feather 50, Colorize/Contrast/Desaturation 0 (Color black) and Enable Motion Blur on at 60. The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration.

verified.note: Soft-edged diagonal wipe from bottom-left with A scaled up (lifted) and ghosting over B at the cut; video frames around the cut confirm a wide feathered angled wipe with push-in.

cards.name: Pop Motion
cards.summary: Film Impact scale transition built for motion graphics: the outgoing element shrinks away and the incoming one pops up with a bounce/overshoot curve and motion blur. On a graphic or PNG with alpha it animates the element in or out over the track below; on full-frame footage the gallery render shrinks the outgoing shot into a small zoom-blurred box on black for 2-3 frames around the cut.
use_for: pop a lower-third, sticker, logo or icon in or out (single-sided on the graphic clip)
list/countdown reels: each item pops in
AI-education explainer: pop diagrams and UI screenshots onto the frame
light satire beats where a meme cut-in should feel punchy
avoid: serious news or a sombre documentary: reads as cartoonish
full-frame footage-to-footage cuts: the shrink exposes black (or the track below) at the cut
very long durations: the bounce turns floaty
cards.equivalent: AE: the 'Pop In' / 'Pop Out' presets (Adobe Express/In and /Out) or 'Pop and Wobble In' (Transitions - Movement) on the layer, or keyframe Scale 0 -> 110 -> 100 with an overshoot expression; enable layer motion blur. ('Scale Bounce' is a per-letter Text preset, not a layer pop.)
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.AE_Impact_Pop (catalog content type fullScreen|motionGraphics). Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 518 s cut (517.52-518.52 s), with no error. For a graphic entrance apply it single-sided at the start of the graphic clip on an upper track; for an exit, at its end. Centred use needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Presets (dropdown 0..7, default 0), Type (dropdown 0..2, default 1), Bounces 3, Initial Velocity 8, Elasticity 10, Frequency 2, Amplitude 60, Decay 100, Ease Out 70, Fade 25, Origin point and Enable Motion Blur on at 45. The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration.

verified.note: At the cut A has shrunk to a small zoom-blurred box on black; a and c are clean full frames of A and B.

cards.name: Pull Motion
cards.summary: Film Impact zoom-through transition: the outgoing picture is pulled toward the viewer (scales up hugely, default Zoom 800) and fades, and the incoming one arrives out of depth with a zoom blur that settles on an eased curve. Works on graphics with alpha and on full frames; on full-frame footage the gallery render passes through black for a few frames at the cut (Fade 60).
use_for: 'pull the audience into the scene' entry from establishing shot to detail
explainer transition into a zoomed diagram or UI detail
graphic/title exit that flies past camera (single-sided)
reel hook: punch into the next shot
avoid: news or documentary cuts where the brief dip to black would read as an act break
shots whose subject is at the frame edge: the zoom pushes it out of frame
stacking with Cross Zoom or Zoom Blur on adjacent cuts: it becomes repetitive
cards.equivalent: AE: Transform Scale keyframes (outgoing 100 -> 300+ with Opacity to 0, incoming from about 300 down to 100) with eased curves, plus CC Radial Fast Blur (zoom) or layer motion blur peaking at the cut.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.AE_Impact_Pull (catalog content type fullScreen|motionGraphics). Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 522 s cut (521.52-522.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips; single-sided on a graphic clip gives a fly-in or fly-out. The gallery .prproj shows controls Presets (dropdown 0..7, default 0), Type (dropdown 0..2, default 0), Bounces 4, Initial Velocity 25, Amplitude 30, Decay 40, Ease Out 70, Fade 60, Origin point, Zoom 800 and Enable Motion Blur on at 60. The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration.

verified.note: Frame b at the cut is black (Fade through black); a shows A starting to scale up and video frames show A zooming toward camera then B arriving out of a zoom blur.

cards.name: Push
cards.summary: GPU Film Impact version of the classic push: the incoming shot slides in and shoves the outgoing shot off-frame, with eased curves and directional motion blur. Default direction brings the incoming shot in from the right and pushes the old one off to the left; stretch, rolling-shutter and chromatic aberration are optional (all 0 by default). It replaces 'Push (Legacy)'.
use_for: timeline/sequence progression in explainers (push left = next step)
news reel story-to-story change
whip-pan style cut between moving B-roll
before -> after comparison in political explainers (push the old figure out, the new one in)
avoid: pushing against the on-screen motion direction: it fights the footage
using it on every cut of a long documentary: feels like a slideshow
cards.equivalent: AE: animate Position of both layers by one frame width with Easy Ease (or a steep speed graph), plus layer motion blur or Directional Blur; Motion Tile with Mirror Edges hides edges if you add overshoot.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.AE_Impact_Push. Apply by the exact name 'Push'; 'Push (Legacy)' is the old CPU version with a separate entry. Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 526 s cut (525.52-526.52 s), with no error; gallery frames show a horizontal push with B entering from the right. Centred needs handles on both clips; single-sided pushes in from (or out to) black or the track below. The gallery .prproj shows controls Direction (dropdown 0..3, default 2), Stretch 0, Blur Amount 26, Rolling Shutter 0, Ease (dropdown 0..3, default 0), Chromatic Aberration 0, Slide (dropdown 0..2, default 0) and curve Type (dropdown 0..2, default 2). The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration.

verified.note: A is shoved off to the left while B slides in from the right with strong horizontal motion blur; c still shows a sliver of A at the left edge.

cards.name: Radial Blur
cards.summary: Film Impact spin-blur transition: the frame smears into a rotational (spin) blur around the centre, peaks in an abstract swirl at the cut with a slight exposure lift, and unwinds into the next shot. With defaults the blur is heavy: 0.3 s either side of the cut both shots are already smeared. Chromatic aberration and slices are optional (0 by default).
use_for: action or sports B-roll cuts with rotating motion
trailer montage hits
reel beat drops
dream/disorientation moments in a documentary reconstruction
avoid: faces and text at the cut: they become unreadable mush for most of the duration
slow, calm sequences
pairing with Spin Motion on the next cut
cards.equivalent: AE: Radial Blur (Type Spin) or CC Radial Blur on an adjustment layer over the cut, Amount keyframed 0 -> peak at the cut -> 0, with a short crossfade underneath.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.AE_Impact_Radial_Blur. Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 530 s cut (529.52-530.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. For a zoom-type blur use 'Zoom Blur' instead; this one spins. The gallery .prproj shows controls Rotation Center (0.5, 0.5), Blur Amount 50, Direction 100 (-100..100, sign = spin direction), Slices 0, Variation 25, Cross Motion off, Chromatic Aberration 0, Exposure 25 and Dissolve Time 60. The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and keep the duration short (0.3-0.5 s) when the shots must stay readable.

verified.note: Heavy rotational spin blur: b is an abstract concentric swirl with slight exposure lift, and both a and c are already strongly smeared.

cards.name: Radial Wipe
cards.summary: New Film Impact shape wipe: the incoming shot is revealed through a radial shape that grows from a centre point. Default is a plain hard-edged circle from frame centre (Roundness 100, Repeats 1, no stroke) that stays small until about the cut and then expands fast; Roundness, Repeats (concentric rings), Mirror, Perspective and coloured Stroke options turn it into diamonds, polygons or ringed graphic wipes. It is NOT the corner-pivot sweep of 'Radial Wipe (Legacy)'.
use_for: reveal a detail or location from a point of interest (iris-in on a subject)
explainer transition to a map or diagram
stylised reel cut with repeated coloured rings
retro or graphic opener for a segment
avoid: serious hard news: the hard circle reads as dated, repeats and strokes look gimmicky
an off-subject centre point: the reveal draws the eye to empty space
cards.equivalent: AE: Iris Wipe (Transition) with Iris Points 32 (closest to a circle) or a Shape-layer ellipse track matte scaled up; repeats = several stroked ellipses with staggered Scale keyframes. CC Radial ScaleWipe for a distorted version.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.Impact_Radial_Wipe (no 'AE_' in the middle, unlike its siblings). Apply by the exact name 'Radial Wipe'; 'Radial Wipe (Legacy)' is the old corner-pivot sweep, and 'Clock Wipe' / 'Clock Wipe (Legacy)' are the clock-hand sweeps. Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 534 s cut (533.52-534.52 s), with no error; gallery frames show a hard-edged circle of B growing from the centre. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Roundness 100, Angle 0, Reverse Direction off, Center (0.5, 0.5), Mirror off, Repeats 1, Wipe Feather 0, Repeat Feather 0, Perspective 100, Enable Stroke off (Width 5, Color #FFC370) and curve Type (dropdown 0..1, default 0). The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration.

verified.note: Hard-edged circle of B from frame centre: tiny in a, about a third of the frame height at the cut, nearly full-frame in c.

cards.name: Ray
cards.summary: Film Impact light wipe: a feathered wipe edge (default 45 degrees) throws volumetric light rays (god-rays) with a warm bloom, slight chromatic aberration and exposure lift across the frame, covering the cut and clearing onto the next shot.
use_for: inspirational or achievement moments (launches, ceremonies, wins)
memory/flashback entry in documentaries
trailer title or logo reveal
AI/tech 'aha' moment in an explainer
avoid: dark sombre content: the bright bloom feels celebratory
shots without bright areas: rays look pasted on
frequent use: it loses its punch quickly
cards.equivalent: AE: CC Light Rays or CC Light Burst 2.5 on an adjustment layer with Intensity and Exposure keyframed to peak at the cut, over a feathered Linear Wipe (or a short crossfade) between the clips underneath.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.AE_Impact_Rays (the catalog names it 'Ray'). Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 538 s cut (537.52-538.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips; single-sided works as a 'burst in from light' opener. The gallery .prproj shows controls Ray Type (dropdown 0..1, default 0), Ray Length 75, Softness 5, Wipe Angle 45, Reverse Direction off, Wipe Feather 20, Color #FFDFB3, Colorize 25, Ambient Amount 0, Desaturate 0, Chromatic Aberration 20, Exposure 20 and Blend Mode (dropdown 0..2, default 0). The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration.

verified.note: At the cut A and B are blended with light rays fanning out from the lower centre and a warm bloom on the right; a and c are clean.

cards.name: Roll
cards.summary: Film Impact directional roll (not a rotation): the picture scrolls through the frame like a slot-machine reel or an old TV vertical roll, wrapping around and travelling a couple of frame heights (Rolls 2) with heavy directional motion blur, then lands on the incoming shot. Default direction is vertical; zoom, stretch, skew and chromatic aberration are optional (0 by default).
use_for: vertical whip between shots that tilt up or down
reel beat-synced shot changes
trailer or montage high-energy sequences
list/countdown reels: roll to the next item like a reel spinning
avoid: talking heads and interviews
text-heavy frames: captions smear into streaks
calm documentary pacing
cards.equivalent: AE: Offset effect (Shift Center To keyframed by 1-2 frame heights, which wraps the image) on each layer, cut or crossfade at the midpoint, plus Directional Blur at 0 degrees (vertical) or layer motion blur; Motion Tile can replace Offset.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.AE_Impact_Roll. Do not confuse it with '3D Roll' (perspective cube roll), 'Film Roll' (film strip) or legacy 'Roll Away'. Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 542 s cut (541.52-542.52 s), with no error; gallery frames show the images scrolling vertically with strips of A and B stacked and strong vertical blur. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Direction (dropdown 0..3, default 1), Rolls 2 (0..5), Ease (dropdown 0..3, default 0), Zoom 0, Stretch 0, Skew 0, Skew Curve 0, Blur Amount 30, Rolling Shutter 0, Chromatic Aberration 0 and curve Type (dropdown 0..2, default 2). The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration.

verified.note: Vertical roll: a is A smeared by vertical motion blur, b shows B rolling down from the top over A, c shows B with a strip of A at the bottom.

cards.name: Shape Flow
cards.summary: Film Impact 'smart' reveal: the transition spreads outward from start points (default one, at frame centre), delayed by detected objects, edges and luminance, so graphics with alpha are flowed off and drawn on shape by shape, with an optional coloured gradient trail. On plain full-frame footage with defaults it acts as a circle that shrinks the outgoing shot to a point on black and grows the incoming one back from the centre.
use_for: reveal an illustration, map or logo as if it is being drawn (single-sided on the graphic)
explainer: diagram or infographic build-on
documentary archival sketch or map reveal over a paper/texture background
title card or end card appearance
avoid: full-frame footage-to-footage cuts with defaults: it becomes a dated iris through black
fast-paced reels: it needs time to read
cards.equivalent: AE: Gradient Wipe using a radial gradient or a blurred luma copy of the layer as the Gradient Layer with some Transition Softness; or Stroke / Trim Paths on traced shapes as a track matte for a true draw-on.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.AE_Impact_Shape_Flow (catalog content type fullScreen|motionGraphics). Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 546 s cut (545.52-546.52 s), with no error; gallery frames on footage show A inside a shrinking circle on black, a dot at the cut, then B in a growing circle. Centred needs handles on both clips; single-sided on a graphic clip draws it on or off over the track below. The gallery .prproj shows controls Start Points (dropdown 0..4, default 0), Point 1 (0.5, 0.5) to Point 5, Start Variation 0, Edge Delay 0, Luma Delay 0, Object Delay 40, Object Variation 0, Reverse off, Trail (dropdown 0..5, default 0), Trail Length 20, Feather 5, Color 1-5 gradient, Blend Mode (dropdown 0..3, default 0) and Opacity 100. The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration; the result depends heavily on the image.

verified.note: On footage it is a circle through black: A in a shrinking circle in a, a tiny dot on black at the cut, B in a growing circle in c.

cards.name: Slice
cards.summary: Film Impact 'ninja' slice: the frame is cut into strips that slide along their length in a staggered cascade with motion blur, pushing the old shot out and the new one in. Default is 7 vertical slices sliding up/down, with thin purple-magenta burn lines on the slice edges (Burn Amount 100 is on by default); Angle turns it horizontal or diagonal.
use_for: food/product or lifestyle reel cuts
news reel story divider with energy
trailer montage 'cutting' beats
data-heavy explainer section change
avoid: faces at the cut: they shear into strips
calm documentary interviews
low-resolution footage: the slice edges alias
cards.equivalent: AE: duplicate the layer into N strips with rectangular masks and stagger Position keyframes (Sequence Layers) with motion blur, plus thin coloured solids on the strip edges; Venetian Blinds or Card Wipe (many columns, 1 row) as a rougher stand-in.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.AE_Impact_Slice. Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 550 s cut (549.52-550.52 s), with no error; gallery frames show vertical strips of A and B offset vertically with magenta edge lines. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Slices 7 (2..31), Position (0.5, 0.5), Angle 0, Distance 100, Reverse Direction off, Cross Motion off, Randomize off, Delay 100, Variation 0, Dissolve Time 20, Edge Behavior (dropdown 0..4, default 1), Burn Color #380529, Burn Amount 100, Burn Thickness 10, Burn White 50 and Enable Motion Blur on at 25. The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration.

verified.note: Seven vertical strips slide up and down in a staggered cascade with thin magenta burn lines on the slice edges, mixing A and B strips.

cards.name: Solarize
cards.summary: Film Impact tonal-inversion transition: across the cut the image solarizes, with highlights and shadows flipping into a burnt, partly negative picture and glowing streaks, then it resolves into the next shot. Defaults (Red Gain +25, Green -50, Blue -100, Glow 48) give an orange-brown, fire-like negative at the cut and grey posterized patches either side; the teal look in the dashboard demo comes from that demo's footage.
use_for: music/concert or nightlife reels
trippy dream/drug/hallucination sequences
trailer stylised hit between acts
satire beat where reality 'flips'
avoid: skin-tone-critical or serious news content
corporate or government explainers: it reads as edgy
long durations: the negative look becomes harsh
cards.equivalent: AE: Curves with an inverted-V (solarize) curve or Invert with Blend With Original, keyframed to peak at the cut on an adjustment layer, plus Tint/Colorama toward orange, Exposure and a short crossfade underneath. AE has no Solarize effect.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.AE_Impact_Solarize. Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 554 s cut (553.52-554.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Glow Amount 48, Angle 180, Length 64, Thickness 16, Red Gain 25, Green Gain -50, Blue Gain -100, Color #CC946F, Contrast 20, Desaturation 20 and Dissolve Time 40. The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration.

verified.note: At the cut the picture is an orange-brown fiery solarized negative with glowing streaks; a and c show grey posterized patches.

cards.name: Spin Motion
cards.summary: Film Impact rotation transition built for motion graphics: the outgoing element spins away (default Angle 1799, about five turns, with a dolly zoom and motion blur) and the incoming one spins into place on an eased curve. On full-frame footage both shots tilt and shrink, exposing black corners, and the cut passes through a near-black swirl for a few frames.
use_for: spin a logo, sticker or icon in or out (single-sided on the graphic)
reel transitions on a beat
explainer: rotate to the next diagram state
light comedic or satire beats
avoid: serious or tragic news
full-frame documentary cuts: black corners and a dip to black at the cut
faces at the cut
back-to-back use with Roll or Radial Blur
cards.equivalent: AE: keyframe Rotation (0 -> 1x to 5x) with Scale down/up on the layer, Easy Ease and layer motion blur; CC Radial Blur peaking at the cut for a full-frame version.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.AE_Impact_Spin (catalog content type fullScreen|motionGraphics). Do not confuse it with legacy 'Spin', 'Spin Away', 'Multi-Spin' or the new Film Impact '3D Spin'. Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 558 s cut (557.52-558.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Presets (dropdown 0..7, default 0), Type (dropdown 0..2, default 1), Bounces 3, Frequency 3, Amplitude 16, Decay 80, Ease Out 70, Fade 60, Origin point, Angle 1799, Reverse Angle off, Dolly 100 and Enable Motion Blur on at 45. The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration.

verified.note: A and B are tilted with black corners in a and c, and the cut is a near-black spiral swirl.

cards.name: Split
cards.summary: Film Impact split: the outgoing frame breaks along a line (default nearly horizontal, tilted -7.5 degrees, through frame centre) into two halves that push apart with a zoom and motion blur, revealing the incoming shot in the widening gap; Mode can reverse it so the halves close in. It replaces 'Split (Legacy)'.
use_for: 'two sides of the story' cut in political debate or comparison explainers
reveal of a key shot or title behind the split
action/sports reel cuts
trailer act transitions
avoid: placing the split line through a face: the default line crosses frame centre
overuse in calm documentaries
cards.equivalent: AE: duplicate the outgoing layer, mask each copy to one side of a slightly tilted line, animate the halves apart with Position (plus a slight Scale) and motion blur over the incoming layer.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.AE_Impact_Split. Apply by the exact name 'Split'; 'Split (Legacy)' and 'Center Split' are older straight-line versions. Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 562 s cut (561.52-562.52 s), with no error; gallery frames show A splitting along a near-horizontal line with B in a widening band. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Mode (dropdown 0..1, default 0), Angle -7.5, Split Point (0.5, 0.5), Push 50, Zoom 200, Softness 0, Dolly 0, Edge Behavior (dropdown 0..1, default 0) and Enable Motion Blur on at 60. The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration.

verified.note: A splits along a slightly tilted near-horizontal line, the halves push apart with zoom and motion blur and B shows in the widening band.

cards.name: Spring Motion
cards.summary: Film Impact springy transition built for graphics and stickers with alpha: elements squash and bounce in and out with an elastic overshoot and a slight 3D perspective angle, with motion blur. On full-frame footage the gallery render squashes the outgoing shot into a thin strip, shows black for a couple of frames and springs the incoming shot open.
use_for: bounce-in for lower thirds, callouts, price tags or stats (single-sided)
social reel sticker or meme entrances
light explainer UI element pop-ins
fun list items in an AI-tools roundup
avoid: serious, tragic or investigative pieces
full-frame footage cuts in documentaries: too cartoonish and it dips to black
cards.equivalent: AE: Scale (squash) and Position keyframes with an elastic/inertial-bounce expression, or the 'Pop and Wobble In' (Transitions - Movement) and 'Pop In' (Adobe Express/In) presets; enable motion blur.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.AE_Impact_Spring (catalog content type fullScreen|motionGraphics). Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 566 s cut (565.52-566.52 s), with no error. Best used single-sided at a graphic clip's start or end on an upper track; centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Presets (dropdown 0..7, default 0), Type (dropdown 0..2, default 1), Bounces 3, Frequency 1, Amplitude 75, Decay 80, Ease Out 70, Fade 60, Angle 0, Reverse Angle off, Scale Width 14, Origin 70 and Enable Motion Blur on at 45. The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration.

verified.note: At the cut A is squashed into a thin strip near the top of a black frame; a and c are clean A and B.

cards.name: Star Wipe
cards.summary: Film Impact multi-shape iris wipe: the incoming shot is revealed through a shape growing from a centre point. Default is a plain hard-edged 5-point star from frame centre with no stroke; Points (3-20), Pointiness, Roundness, Spin, Repeats, Mirror and Stroke turn it into flowers, polygons, diamonds or neon ringed shapes.
use_for: deliberately cheesy or ironic satire beats
retro 80s/90s-style or music reels
kids/fun explainer segments
celebration or award moments in social edits
avoid: straight news, documentary or anything serious: the classic star reads as cheap or ironic
plain defaults when the edit is meant to look modern: the bare star looks 2000s, so treat it as a deliberate joke or skip it
cards.equivalent: AE: Iris Wipe with Use Inner Radius on and Iris Points 10 (the count includes inner vertices, so 10 = a 5-point star; range 6-32); or a Star shape-layer track matte scaled up, with stroked duplicates for neon rings.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.AE_Impact_Star_Wipe. Legacy 'Iris Star' is the plain old version. Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 570 s cut (569.52-570.52 s), with no error; gallery frames show a hard-edged 5-point star of B growing from the centre. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Points 5 (3..20), Pointiness 67, Roundness 0, Angle 0, Spin 0, Reverse Direction off, Center (0.5, 0.5), Mirror off, Repeats 1, Wipe Feather 0, Perspective 100 and Enable Stroke off (Width 5, Color #FFC370). The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration.

verified.note: Hard-edged 5-point star of B grows from frame centre with no stroke: small in a, large at the cut, almost full-frame in c.

cards.name: Stretch Wipe
cards.summary: Film Impact rubbery wipe: pixels along the wipe edge stretch into long streaks (jelly/rubber feel) on both clips as the incoming shot is pulled across, with a slight exposure lift and strong motion blur. Default angle wipes vertically, bottom to top, with vertical streaks; Angle sets any other direction.
use_for: fast reel cuts on a beat
night or neon footage where the streaks glow
trailer speed transitions
sports/action highlight packages
avoid: faces and text at the cut: they smear grotesquely
slow documentary or interview cuts
cards.equivalent: AE: CC Scale Wipe (Transition), which stretches pixels from a Center along a Direction (Stretch -100..100), keyframed across the cut, plus Directional Blur; or Linear Wipe with a slit-scan/Time Displacement smear.
cards.scripting: Film Impact transition built into Premiere Pro 2026, match name AE.AE_Impact_Stretch_Wipe. Do not confuse it with 'Stretch' (two entries in the transition list: the legacy one and the new Film Impact whole-frame stretch) or legacy 'Stretch In' / 'Stretch Over' / 'Cross Stretch'. Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 574 s cut (573.52-574.52 s), with no error; gallery frames show B rising from the bottom with vertical streaks. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Angle 0, Reverse Direction off, Stretch 25, Stretch Clip A on, Stretch Clip B on, Exposure 10, Edge Behavior (dropdown 0..2, default 0) and Enable Motion Blur on at 80. The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration.

verified.note: Bottom-to-top wipe with long vertical pixel streaks on both clips along the edge: B fills the bottom at the cut, streaked A remains on top.
